references.text: Kishon is mentioned again as one of the Levitical cities given to the sons of Gershon from the tribe of Issachar.
Rabbith and the other cities in this verse are part of the same geographical description of Issachar's inheritance.
Kishon (called Kedesh here) is mentioned as a Levitical city in the territory of Issachar in the parallel account in Chronicles.
